values.REJECT: Return both UTC candidates and require an explicit choice.
values.EARLIER_OFFSET: Select the earlier UTC instant (fold=0 in ordinary backward transitions).
values.LATER_OFFSET: Select the later UTC instant (fold=1 in ordinary backward transitions).

values.START_OF_SPRING: Year pillar changes at the global UTC instant of apparent solar longitude 315 degrees.

values.MIDNIGHT: Sexagenary day changes at 00:00 local apparent solar time.
values.ZI_START_23: Sexagenary day changes at 23:00 local apparent solar time.

values.CLASSICAL_CONTINUOUS: Late Zi retains the old day pillar but derives the hour stem from the next day's stem.
values.CURRENT_DAY_STEM: Late Zi retains the old day pillar and derives the hour stem from that same day's stem.
values.ZI_START_ROLLOVER: At 23:00 both day pillar and hour-stem derivation use the next day; requires ZI_START_23.

values.LOCAL_SOLAR_DATE_INDEXED: Map the complete local apparent solar Gregorian date through the unified Chinese calendar.
values.ABSOLUTE_CALENDAR: Use the official Chinese-calendar mapping of the reported civil Gregorian date.

values.FULLBOOK_NEXT_MONTH: For life/body placement only, treat a leap month as the following month.
values.ZHONGZHOU_FIXED_15: For life/body placement only, days 1-15 use the current month and later days the next month.
values.CURRENT_MONTH: For life/body placement only, retain the leap month's nominal month.
values.TRUE_HALF_SPLIT: For life/body placement only, divide the actual month length into two halves.
